description:
Job Title: Full Stack Cloud Developer
Location: Dallas, TX
Duration: Full Time

Client: JPMC (Keep it confidential)
Position: Full stack cloud developer or UI/UX Developer (Full Stack Digital Developer)
Location: Dallas, TX
Job Description:
Must Have
• Full stack J2EE/UI developer – 5+ years of experience
o Core Java
o Spring 4
o Spring Boot
o Spring Cloud
o Distributed Cache Technologies
o Java Persistence APIs
o ORM frameworks
o Previous experience in UI development with jQuery/Bootstrap or similar frameworks
o Competency in newer UI frameworks (Angular.js or React.js or similar) – fast learner to pick up similar frameworks quickly
• Demonstrated experience is developing Micro-Services & Cloud Native Applications in Pivotal Cloud Foundry (Or any other flavor of Cloud Foundry)
• Experience in working in a distributed environment with different integration techniques – 3+ years of experience
o Synchronous REST services
o Asynchronous Messaging
o Web Sockets
• Understanding and the ability to apply design patterns in code
• Demonstrated ability to design highly available, fault tolerant systems that can scale from user stories
• Demonstrated ability to write automation test cases for regression testing
• Proven ability to work in a fast paced agile environment with short sprints
• Experience in working for at least 1 relational database
• Experience in working with at least 1 non-relational database
• Experience in writing code free from vulnerabilities
• Fast learner – picking up new technologies
 Good to Have
• Demonstrated capability in contribution to Open Source movement – contribution is available to review on GIT Hub
• A small percentage of overall experience spent in Wall Street IT shops (20% experience in Wall St, 80% experience in Silicon Valley is the sweet spot)
• Understanding & demonstrated experience in Domain Driven Design Principles 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
